Heavy Rains Cause LPG Cylinders to Wash Away at HPCL Plant in Raigad

Heavy rains in Raigad district caused approximately 3,000 LPG cylinders to be washed away from an HPCL bottling plant near the Patalganga river. The incident highlights the potential risks of flooding on industrial sites and the importance of disaster preparedness.
